title: fix(approvals): a step that resolves to nobody tells the submitter and names the remedy; the platform administrators' slot reads by a label
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D62xGLMbyWJaMEVnAMEjTK1)_
Fixes #35316
Fixes #34410
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：一人组织里提交的审批（工时、报销等）没人能批时，提交人会收到通知，请求时间线也写明「暂时没有其他人能审批，需要组织管理员添加一名能审批的成员」；提交人自己点批准被拒时，拒绝文案也给出同样的办法；平台管理员审批位在列表里显示为「平台管理员」而不是一串内部地址。
- 为什么做：审批流程里「审批人解析为空」的问题（一人组织的工时审批卡住，和平台级审批在没有平台管理员的部署上卡住）。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是提交人多收到一条通知或提示文字不准确，审批规则本身不变（提交人仍不能批自己的请求），可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

**#35316 — a request no one can approve tells its submitter and names the remedy.** When an approval step resolves to no one and no administrator other than the submitter can take it (the HotCRM one-person organization with `excludeSubmitter: true`), the request still opens on the slate that names no one (`onEmptyApprovers` semantics untouched), and now:

- writes a system note on its timeline (`no-approver-note.ts`, snapshot key `__noApproverNote`, overlaid in the reader's language by `localizeRoutingNotes` like its two sibling notes): "No one else can approve this request yet. An organization administrator must add a member who can approve it, then reassign the request to them." When the slate kept an unstaffed literal, it names it: "…must add a member who holds position 'legal'; that member can then decide it.";
- tells the submitter under the existing `approval.comment` topic (no new topic; the note is a comment on the request's thread), keyed text `approvalNoApproverTitle` / the note's sentence, no actor;
- the two refusals of the submitter's own approval (the `excludeSubmitter` check and the option-B override refusal) end with that same remedy when no one but the submitter is on the slate, and keep their current text when someone is;
- `approvalSubmitterExcludedNoOne` no longer promises "only a privileged override can decide it": it reads "…because this step sets excludeSubmitter, and no one else could take it." The ruling stands: no self-approval, not even through the override.

**#34410 — the platform administrators' slot.** `platform_admin:*` is labelled "Platform administrators": in English on the stored `pending_approver_labels`, and in the reader's language in the approvals door's `pending_approver_names`. For the warning half I chose the **guide arm**: one sentence in `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx` (Routing to the platform administrators, "Nobody is told"). A runtime warning would need the population question "does anyone hold platform standing", which `hasPlatformAdminStanding` (core) is deliberately not built to answer and whose only implementation lives in plugin-auth; a second derivation here is what that predicate's header forbids.

All new sentences ship in the eleven locales the package ships. The guide's "When a slate names no one" paragraph is updated to say the submitter is told.

## Evals

No eval surface: this is server copy and notification behaviour, pinned by the tests below.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/exclude-submitter.integration.test.ts` — expect the describe "a request no one but its submitter can decide names the remedy" (3 tests) green.

Files to read first, by risk:
1. `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts` — the `decideNode` hunk (`noOneElse` / `noApproverRemedy`): the only change on a refusal path; the ruled refusals still throw before any write.
2. `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/no-approver-note.ts` — `namesNoOneBut` decides which text a refusal shows.
3. `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/translations/messages.ts` — eleven locales.

<details><summary>Tests</summary>

- `exclude-submitter.integration.test.ts`: new describe — the no-one slate writes the note, sends one `approval.comment` notice to the submitter only, and the `excludeSubmitter` refusal ends with the remedy; the override refusal names `position 'legal'` when only that literal is left; CONTROL: with another approver on the slate both refusals keep their old text and no notice is sent. The existing solo-organization pin is updated to the corrected note.
- `platform-admin-approver-34218.test.ts`: the slot's stored label and the door's `pending_approver_names` read "Platform administrators".
- Two fixtures updated as consequences (not loosened): `approval-requested-notification.integration.test.ts` now expects the submitter's `approval.comment` notice on a slate of literals with no administrator (still no `approval.requested`); `approval-service.test.ts` picks the holder's comment from a timeline that now also carries the system note.
- At head `a3f98b15`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals build && … typecheck && … test` under the verify lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, Test Files 124 passed (124), Tests 1770 passed (1770); test-typecheck ledger held. Diff: 11 files, +335 / -36.
</details>

<details><summary>Clause-② measurement</summary>

Built `dist/index.d.ts` / `index.d.mts` at head vs. the same package built from the base source (`eca20d22`): the only difference is one JSDoc line on the private `enrichRows` docblock. No export, key or topic was added; `ApprovalsTranslations` is typed `TranslationBundle`, so the new message ids do not reach the declaration closure.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Ruling consistency: the 2026-11-17 option-B ruling holds (both refusals still throw for the submitter); ADR-0044 D1 (`returned` status) untouched; ADR-0068 D2 (platform_admin is a built-in identity, no new boolean) untouched — only a display label; ADR-0055 §1/§2 (master-detail) and ADR-0061 D2 (record search) govern nothing this diff touches; ADR-0027 has no §14 on this tree (sections 1–9; §6 governs publish approvals, not runtime slates).
- A submitter who is not an administrator and holds no slot still gets the generic "not a pending approver" refusal; only the two refusals the card names carry the remedy.
- The stored `pending_approver_labels` is English by design (a stored snapshot, like person names); the reader's language is served on the door.
- `docs/audits/…/plugin-approvals.md` tenant census regenerated for the one new elevated `sys_approval_action` insert.
- Commits: one per card, plus a fixture commit and a census commit for #35316 found by the post-commit test and gate runs (the branch is not `claude/issue-*`, so no force-push to fold them).
